{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212740/c29d67bc6d8505c804d977373e5662a3b6c74971.png
Enter into the Endless Possibility!
Hello, Admirals.

Uncharted Waters Origin will be undergoing a data patch on Nov. 12 to address identified issues.

Please refer to the following information for details.

Nov. 12 Data Patch
1. Data Patch Schedule: Nov. 12  17:07 (UTC+9)
* The data patch will proceed without maintenance.
* The game will therefore be available to play while the data patch is underway.

2. Issues To Be Fixed During Patch
Wardrobe: Issue where Sayyida al Hurra's Wardrobe and Natasha's Wardrobe are displayed
Bartering: Issue where the Trade Protection purchase condition for Increase Barter Count on the Barter screen remains as a condition after purchasing the Trade Protection product
Exploration: Issue where Land Exploration ends as one time even when doing it in a row

3. To Note
- Please exit the game completely before logging in again for the patch to be applied.

Please be advised that players may experience temporary disconnections while the patch is underway.

We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.
Thank you.

Hello, Admirals.

Jul. 21 (Fri) Data Patch

1. Data Patch Schedule: Jul. 21 (Fri) 15:50 (UTC+9) 
 * The data patch will proceed without maintenance. 
 * The game will therefore be available to play while the data patch is underway. 

2. Data Patch Details 
Assault: The issue where an error occurs on some mobile devices when the Fire Ship retreats from outer waters during the Thomas Tew Assault will be fixed.
Logbook: The issue where Korean text is shown in some records will be fixed.
Parts: The issue where the Discoveries button is visible when previewing Parts near Discoveries will be fixed.
UI: The issue where the effect that is shown when equipping gear in Mate Details still shows after users have exited and re-entered the UI will be fixed.
UI: The issue where when the Mate icon in the Related Mate pop-up is pressed, the location pop-up opens behind the Related Mate pop-up will be fixed.

Please be advised that players may experience temporary disconnections while the patch is underway. 

We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services. 

Thank you.

Privilege: The issue where the icons for the Advance Pass and Epic Pass are replaced with placeholder icon images will be fixed.
Privilege: The issue where the total sailing days were being displayed incorrectly higher on Event > Privilege > Advance Pass will be fixed.

- Please exit the game completely before logging in again for the patch to be applied.
Please be advised that players may experience temporary disconnections while the patch is underway.
